title: Tamsin and the Escarpment
author: V. M. Thackeray
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
